status: Authorised by the operator (2026-11-20 20:59 UTC): at most 120 games, once, only after the zero-game audit passes. FROZEN before any game: sha256, implementation hashes, audit sha256 and every assignment are journalled in balance/v5_2/journal.ndjson ('v52-preregistered').
question: How much of the ev-k1 to ev-k1.1 behaviour change (stall, first-mover pattern) is due to C4, how much to the weak legacy seed mixing of the planner's own randomness, and do they interact?
nature: Exploratory, 30 games per arm. No universal balance correction and no precise tail-risk estimate is claimed.
planner: server/balance/v5_2/planner.ts ('k1x-1'): ev-k1 + C1 + C2 + C3 in every arm. Executor in every arm: the C1-C3 executor (ev-k1.1 nextMoves11). Verified before the run: (C4 off, legacy) == V5.1 ablation { c1, c2, c3 } and (C4 on, legacy) == ev-k1.1, decision by decision.

B_stream.legacy: rng((seed ^ Math.imul(turn + 7, 0x9e3779b1)) >>> 0), one stream for noise and temperature
B_stream.mixed: server/balance/v5_2/stream.ts stream-1: SHA-256 counter stream, domains (seed, turn, mover role F/S, purpose 'noise' | 'temperature')

seeds.derivation: dispersed = 200000 + (first 32 bits of sha256('rule-sabotage/v5.2/dispersed-seed/' + i) mod 3999000000), i = 0..7
seeds.design: every arm on all 15 seeds x both first movers = 30 games per arm, 120 total
seeds.excluded: holdout 65001-65060 and every range used before (all earlier game seeds are below 100000)

hypotheses.H1_coverage: Under the mixed stream the temperature draws actually used in games spread over [0,1] across seeds at the same turn (sd >= 0.2 where at least 5 games roll), while under legacy they do not (sd < 0.05).
hypotheses.H2_mixing_effect: Within C4 on, the turn-limit rate differs between legacy and mixed (A4 - A2, two-sided).
hypotheses.H3_C4_effect: Within the mixed stream, C4 changes the turn-limit rate or mean length (A4 - A3, two-sided).
hypotheses.H4_interaction: The C4 effect differs between streams: (A4 - A3) - (A2 - A1) != 0 (turn-limit rate and mean length).
hypotheses.H5_first_mover: Reported for every arm and contrast; no direction predicted.

metrics: temperature-roll draws used (per turn across seeds: sd, uniformity)
decision at near-tie turns, incl. the turn-21 branch (chosen rank when the window holds > 1 candidate)
plan/execution agreement (corrected; required = 1 only for C4-on arms)
strategic prefixes vs realized two-turn trajectories
uncertainty: seed-blocked bootstrap (blocks = the 2 games of a seed), contrasts paired by seed across arms, 5000 resamples; consecutive and dispersed blocks also reported separately

decisionRules.contrast: SUPPORTED if the paired 95% interval excludes 0; NOT SUPPORTED if it lies within +-0.10 (turn-limit rate) or +-3 turns (length); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decisionRules.H1: SUPPORTED if the mixed-stream sd condition holds at every turn with >= 5 rolls and legacy's does not; otherwise as observed
decisionRules.failure: Any replay failure, illegal move or engine error invalidates the affected arm for H2-H4 (reported, not rerun). Plan/execution disagreement in a C4-on arm invalidates that arm.

after: Stop at READY_FOR_OPERATOR_V5_2_RANDOMIZATION_REVIEW. No further games, no Kane.
